title: Agent owns all safe work
summary: The agent owns every permitted, bounded, reversible or containable, observable task for which it has sufficient evidence and an active Mandate; a named human is engaged only for authority changes, materially irreversible consequences, Mandate excess, or Material Uncertainty that can change the business outcome.

decisions.text: Agent-Owned Work includes all permitted, bounded, reversible or containable, observable work supported by sufficient evidence and the active Mandate.
A Human Decision Gate is used only for authority grants or expansion, materially irreversible consequences, Mandate excess, or unresolved Material Uncertainty that can change the business outcome.

requirements: The agent researches allowed sources before escalating low-risk missing data.
The agent synthesizes proposed results and executes routine work inside the active Mandate.
The agent preserves evidence for completed work.
A Human Decision Gate contains a recommendation, evidence, confidence, alternatives, and consequences rather than a blank questionnaire.
Discoverable facts are agent inputs rather than required human fields.
External actions within an approved Mandate remain Agent-Owned Work; authority changes and material exposure remain human-owned.
constraints: Work must be permitted and bounded.
Work must be reversible or its consequences containable.
The agent must have sufficient evidence.
Execution must remain inside the active Mandate.
